_comment: Municipal drop-in schedules read by mapsee_ingest_perfectmind.py from PerfectMind (Xplor Recreation / nextRec) BookMe4 widgets. Read the adapter's header before adding a tenant: only BookingType 2 calendars are read, private-booking calendars and rows are refused by a shared rule (childminding, external trainers, birthday parties, court reservations, orientations, equipment lending, appointments; and a session whose title says members only or whose Details require a membership or pass the source does not call free (the Details half was 5,253 rows on 2026-10-03: Surrey's Seniors Services, Markham's fitness classes, Brampton's Flower City Seniors Centre)), and `exclude_calendars` / `exclude_title_rx` are for what that rule misses. A widget's "No fee" is what the WIDGET charges: when Details say the row is not sold online (Markham's drop-in aquafit, $7.58 at the desk) no price is written, and a hidden price (DisplayPrices false) writes no price line at all. `venues` places a facility the widget gives no point, or overrides one the widget puts in the wrong place (checked against OpenStreetMap for all 118 venues on 2026-10-03: 5 were 460 m to 6.0 km off), with its provenance in `_coords`. `widgets` may list several; calendars are de-duplicated by Id.
